Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning a business and occupation tax deduction for donated medical services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a business and occupation tax deduction fordonated medical services; and adding a new section to chapter 82.04RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A health care provider may deduct from the measure of tax thevalue of medical services donated through a community-based health caresystem, which is financed and supported solely through the charity careof health care providers. (2) This act applies to amounts received by a taxpayer on or afterAugust 1, 2012.
